about: The camera keeps the player's view (issue #176): zoomed out to 400 units on one field, it stays at 400 on another field; an indoor map has its own view (300 by default), and going back outdoors brings the 400 back. A double Ctrl+right-click puts it back to 300 at the end. A client the harness drives keeps its view to itself (nothing is written to the player's settings).
